The pre-order deals on the new Apple HomeView are still rolling alongside the $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3 and a chance to secure some 2026 Apple Polishing Cloths at $9 Prime shipped, but we do have a series of other deals to scope out as we move into Week 2 of Black Friday month. Alongside Apple’s most affordable M5 MacBook Air now $200 off and the 1TB models at $250 off via Amazon, we also have some MacBook Pro PROLED XDR touch display deals to scope out – up to $150 gift card with purchase or open-box units at nearly $150 off. You will still find a range of Apple Watch Ultra 4 models at nearly $100 off, a deal on Apple’s Dynamic Power Adapter to fast charge iPhone Duo, and new all-time lows on the latest Beats 10-foot 240W Braided USB-C cables from $13 Prime shipped. All of that and more awaits below.

Stocking stuffer alert: 2026 Apple Polishing Cloth back in-stock at $9 Prime shipped

The 2026 next-generation Apple Polishing Cloth is making a triumphant return and is now back in-stock. After completely selling out at Amazon, you can now once again purchase the only way to properly clean a foldable iPhone display or the new touchscreen MacBook – score one now for $9 Prime shipped before they are gone for good.

  • 2026 Apple Polishing Cloth $9 – Back in-stock

AirPods Pro 3 $50 off, AirPods Max 2 $100 off in early Black Friday sales launching today

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)

Amazon’s pre-order discount on the new Apple HomeView is back

Amazon’s pre-order discount on the new Apple HomeView has returned once again today. While shipping at times at Apple have gotten better on some models, Amazon is now selling it for less and delivering quicker to some regions of the country.

Over at Amazon you’ll now find the new Apple HomeView starting down at $289.99 shipped. You likely know the drill already here with these early pre-order deals on Apple gear at Amazon – the price drop isn’t huge, but it is still less than Apple and just about everywhere else so you might as well keep some coffee money in your pocket.

Most affordable M5 MacBook Air now $200 off, upgraded 1TB models at $250 off

Alongside the return all-time lows on various Apple Watch Ultra 4 models at nearly $100 off, the $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3, and the pre-order discount on the new Apple HomeView, some of the most notable early Black Friday deals we have tracked thus far are landing on the latest M5 MacBook Air lineup. Alongside the particularly notable $250 price drops on the mid-tier 13- and 15-inch models, you can also score the most affordable current MacBook Air down at the lowest price we have tracked in months as we move into Week 2 of Black Friday month.

As mentioned above, and as we featured the moment it went live, Amazon is delivering a pair of M5 MacBook Air configurations with some seriously notable $250 price drops right now:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,349 (Reg. $1,599) – $250 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,549 (Reg. $1,799) – $250 off

These two configurations are easily the two best buys in current-generation MacBooks right now and, frankly, the best deals we have tracked since June – we are talking bout truly Black Friday-worthy pricing here.

That said, they are going to cost you at least $250 more than the most affordable entry model, which happens to also be setting at the lowest price we have tracked on it in months:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (Reg. $1,299)

This is $200 off, compared to the $250 off on the models above, but it is still a solid discount on a much more inexpensive and respectable 16GB/512GB machine at $250 less than the next most affordable model Amazon sells.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,599 (Reg. $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,299 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,799 (Reg. $1,999)

Apple Watch Ultra 4

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 4 Milanese Loop $799 (Reg. $899)
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 4 Burgundy Trail $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 4 Burgundy Alpine $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 Translucent Gray Ocean $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 Milanese Loop $799 (Reg. $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 Desert Alpine $699 (Reg. $799)

Don’t pay full price to fast charge iPhone Duo with Apple’s Dynamic Power Adapter, Amazon has it for less

The iPhone Duo is out there now and Apple specifically recommends you use its 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max to fast charge the new foldable. Just don’t buy one direct, you can get it for less on Amazon right now.

Amazon is offering the official Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max down at $34.99 with free shipping for Prime members or in orders over $35.

New PROLED XDR Touch Display MacBook Pro deals: Up to $145 off, FREE $150 gift card, more

The all-new Apple MacBook Pro with the PROLED XDR touch display is now out in the wild and, while we are still awaiting the first cash discount at Amazon ahead of Black Friday, there are some savings up for grabs here. Alongside the up to $145 off “excellent” condition open-box units at Best Buy, you can also secure yourself a FREE $150 gift card on a brand new unit too.

There is a chance we see some cash discounts on new condition units for Black Friday at Amazon this month, but it’s hard to say for sure. There are some gift card offers still up for grabs for its full week on the market:

  • MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Touch Display from $2,899 + $100 Best Buy gift card
  • MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Touch Display from $2,899 + $150 B&H gift card

Now clearly the authorized Apple dealers over at B&H are serving up a better deal here as far the gift card value goes. However, you could make an argument that, especially at this time of year, a $100 Best Buy gift card might be more valuable than a $150 B&H card for some folks.

Best Buy is running some massive sales this month on just about everything it sells and that extra $100 in store credit might seriously come in handy. B&H is running sales of its own, of course, and if there is some gear there you are waiting for a deal on then the $150 offer there is even better. But considering how much more extensive the product selection is at Best Buy and how deep the deals are there this month, the $100 might go a long way.

Nonetheless, these are the best offers on new condition touchscreen MacBooks thus far, unless you would prefer to save nearly $150 on the most affordable model in “excellent” open-box condition via Best Buy:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro PROLED XDR 24GB/1TB $2,754 (Reg. $2,899)

Beats 10-ft. 240W Braided USB-C cable hits $13 all-time low (56% off) – perfect stocking stuffer

Amazon is now offering the latest 10-foot Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable starting down at $13.29 with free shipping for Prime members or in orders over $25.

  • Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable Navy $13 (Reg. $30)
  • Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable Red $14 (Reg. $30)
  • Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable Stone $16 (Reg. $30)
  • Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable Black $18 (Reg. $30)

Amazon Ring early Black Friday deals are now live from $40: Smart Doorbell 4K $100 off, more

The early Black Friday Ring deals are flying now, with the most affordable 2026 Ring Battery Doorbell 2K down at just $40 and now, the latest Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro at a seriously notable $100 off. We are looking at the return of the lowest prices ever on a series of Amazon’s latest Ring products here – you can get more details and closer look down below.

While only the Deep Silver variant is catching the early Black Friday pricing here today, you can now score the Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro down at $149.99 shipped.

Regularly $250, this is $100 or 40% off the list price and a match for the lowest price we have ever tracked on Amazon. This is, in fact, only the second time we have seen this model down at a price this low. It dropped to $180 during the summer Prime Day event and the same $150 during the massive fall sale.

Ring Doorbells
